h: Finding Hashem Within the Concealment of the Three Weeks

p: אִיתָא בְּשֵׁם הָרַבִּי רַבִּי בֶּער זֵכֶר צַדִּיק לִבְרָכָה
It is related in the name of the Rebbe, Rabbi Ber, may the memory of the righteous be a blessing,
who pursue the attainment of the revelation of Hashem,
like the parable of the king:
when he is not in his palace,
that the twenty-two days of Bein HaMetzarim
correspond to the twenty-two letters of the Torah,
as is found in Midrash Eichah,
that the lamentations, which run from Alef to Tav,
which begin with the letter Alef, "Anochi."
And Tishah B'Av corresponds to Tav,
"Your iniquity is ended (tam), daughter of Tziyon,"
for He poured out His wrath on wood and stones.
And this is the expression "between the straits":
like a strait on this side and a strait on that side,
for the concealment has no spread,
when everything is already repaired and completed
that precisely after the Destruction of the Temple
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁאָמַר בַּמִּדְרָשׁ (תַּנְחוּמָא רֵישׁ פָּרָשַׁת נֹחַ)
And as it says in the Midrash (Tanchuma, beginning of Parshas Noach)
הוּא דַּיְיקָא עַל יְדֵי צַעַר וְיִסּוּרִים
comes precisely through pain and suffering,
שֶׁהַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא קָבַע שְׁתֵּי יְשִׁיבוֹת
that the Holy One, blessed be He, established two yeshivos
and further on it says there
that they do not see the birthpangs of Mashiach;
Yet in truth the two yeshivos existed
such as those of Rav and Shmuel,
עַל שׁוֹרֶשׁ הֶחָרָשׁ וְהַמַּסְגֵּר (מְלָכִים ב כד, טז)
is the root of "the craftsman and the locksmith" (Melachim II 24:16),
as it says (in the Tanchuma there):
and this is the aspect of the prophecy of Yirmiyahu,
once one of them closed, etc.,
there was no one in the world who could open";
and it corresponds to the prophecy of Yeshayahu,
And one may allude to this too
in the question of the Gemara (end of Horayos, 14a):
"One who is sharp and raises objections,
and one who is deliberate and reaches conclusions
is the aspect of the craftsman,
עִם כָּל זֶה הוּא נִשְׁאַר בְּתֵיקוּ
because the aspect of deliberate and concluding
which is precisely in Bein HaMetzarim,
And this is as our Sages, of blessed memory, said
"In the place where baalei teshuvah stand,
and as our Sages, of blessed memory, said (Menachos 29b):
does the leg of the Hei hang? etc.
But let him enter through that one!
one who comes to purify himself is helped."
For through the distance and concealment
to take hold in a higher place above.
